title: fix(ui): restore static checks after copy updates
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Restores static checks broken on main by #192092 and #192046: a duplicate terminal translation property and an unnecessary boolean-literal comparison in device pairing.

## User Impact

No user-visible change. Terminal copy and pairing copy-failure feedback remain identical.

## Why This Change Was Made

Remove the later identical `closeSessionTitle` property, preserving catalog value and order. Use `!copied` for the copy helper's boolean result. English owns the catalog; foreign locales use generated adapters and need no edits. Production delta: -1 line. No baseline, ignore, config, or generated translation changes.

## Evidence

Both lint errors and TypeScript TS1117 reproduced on exact main parent `2270c7c6ba086b32d82eabdcb82bfe1548b438a5`; introducing commits are `a6a1d9c781c2cf7994a16a727fef8c6bf1d5db23` (#192092) and `e3d69a2586833843ad6d8b81e26de8bdcb8e9f69` (#192046).

After repair, targeted type-aware UI lint, scripts typecheck, and keyless i18n verification pass. Focused UI tests: 39/39; Chromium terminal viewport: 1/1; mobile pairing and terminal-page E2E: 5/5. Existing compiler/linter gates provide the failing-before/passing-after regression proof; no duplicate syntax-check test added.

Independent Codex autoreview of the complete two-file local diff against the parent, with copy-helper context, is scoped-clean through P2. Author simplification retains only the two necessary edits. Synthetic owner diagnostics verify identical serialized terminal catalogs and boolean outputs; no runtime performance improvement is claimed.

`pnpm check:changed` passes the targeted lint/type/format/i18n gates but remains red on four unrelated main regressions. All reproduce in an unchanged isolated checkout of exact parent `2270c7c6ba086b32d82eabdcb82bfe1548b438a5`:

- Partial toast mock in `profiles-view.test.tsx:23`, introduced by #192225 (`80c59348c20a`).
- Partial confirm-dialog mock in `sessions-page-cloud-stop.test.ts:18`, introduced by #192206 (`3101c8d324ab`).
- Unused `QUALIFIED_PACKAGE_SMOKE_LANES` export, introduced by #191654 (`42a23ab0744c`).
- Unused `sessionStopCopyKey` export, introduced by #192085 (`6afa9c60f62c`).

These are main regressions requiring separate repair, not ignored failures. No corresponding owner, caller, configuration, or baseline is changed here. Exact-head CI remains required for the two repaired gates; any inherited-only landing will preserve the failed CI state and attribution.

Exact-head CI run [41848491159](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41848491159) completed. All lint stripes, production typechecking, i18n, selected UI E2E, security-fast, and changed-node suites passed. The remaining four failed jobs are inherited, reproduced on CI's exact main parent `1ae47f471b3777becec6c177907c29ba6d1fc896`; tested merge `37d5ebd90ba7e2c4cdb7d97a9500a51a156dfa67` has that baseline and the reviewed PR head as its ordered parents.

- Baseline ratchets: the two partial mocks already attributed above.
- Test-types stripe 5: `config-mutation.test.ts:50` passes invalid phase `disconnected`, introduced by #192208 (`df93e5d0e9a8`).
- UI shard 2: 22 failures. #192225 changed the sidebar admin explanation; #192204 changed Offline to Disconnected; #192057 changed permission-error presentation/fixture requirements and router error copy; #192218 changed the missing-account message.
- UI shard 3: 7 failures. #192057 changed permission-error presentation; #192208 changed model-discovery, installed-agent, access, and inventory-error copy without updating these tests.

All 29 UI cases reproduced in focused runs on the exact main parent (17 + 12 failures, 81 passing sibling cases). Initial baseline dependency-resolution setup failure was corrected with workspace dependency copies and is not counted as reproduction. Source history/blame identifies each introducing change. These are additional main regressions for separate repair, not CI noise. Landing uses the explicitly authorized inherited-failure exception; the aggregate CI gate remains red.
